_notes: Golden-set ground truth for signature-zone detection. Zones are hand-labeled approximations — where a reasonable human signer would expect to place their signature. Coordinates use top-left origin in points (72pt = 1 inch). Use generous IoU thresholds (0.2-0.3) because text-heuristic detection is fuzzy by nature.
